items.title: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
items.authors: Yuntian Deng, Pengyu Nie, Stuart Shieber
items.abstract: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider.
